root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence presents this root in a Quranic figurative use of burying or immersing the soul in sins, resulting in its corruption.
root_idea.development: The Quran-focused lexical explanation interprets دَسَّىٰهَا as an altered form of دَسَّسَهَا, meaning to immerse or bury it in sins. No broader root-development account is supplied.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The group is a Quran-attested lexical verb and is displayed under its normalized perfect-tense citation form.

senses.definition: To bury or corrupt it by immersing it in sins.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic figurative use in وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا, with the object referring to the soul; the form is explained as a phonologically altered form of دَسَّسَهَا.

cautions: No Lane primary or Maqayis evidence was supplied, so no broader Classical Arabic meanings are established in this artifact.
